outcome: HELLP syndrome (hemolysis, elevated liver enzyme levels, and low platelet count)
cohort: The study included 283 unselected singleton pregnancies, each with at least one determination of the soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1-to-placental growth factor ratio.
finding: Increasing sFlt-1-to-PlGF ratio was positively correlated with the severity of placental dysfunction and priority of delivery, and negatively associated with gestational age at delivery, birthweight, and time until delivery.
